note: The ninth plague (darkness) struck Egypt on this day (according to tradition, see Exodus 10:21–23). The Prophet Ezekiel received a prophecy against the kingdom of Egypt. God gave him seven prophecies against Egypt and almost all of them mention the date (see Ezekiel 32:1–2).
prompts: What verse spoke to you most today and why?
Did you learn something you need to do in your life?
